notes.title: Just ONE MONTH AWAY until AVGN 8-bit Launches!
notes.content:
AVGN 8-bit releases in just ONE MONTH on October 23, 2025!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/07a2af6bf2b03331c8558aa6c1e567540a0ba818.gif"]
When a digital monstrosity threatens all of gaming, The Nerd must use the powers of evil--aka the powers of the "worst" games imaginable--against the corrupted powers of good!Battle through 6 levels of monster-killing, platforming insanity, and take down challenging bosses, both new and familiar to the AVGN universe!And enjoy live-action cutscenes featuring The Nerd himself as he reacts to the player's progression throughout the game!

notes.title: AVGN 8-bit LAUNCHES on October 23, 2025!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that AVGN 8-bit will be releasing on October 23, 2025! Get a sneak peak at even more gameplay and, for the first time ever, live action cutscenes featuring The Nerd himself!

Check out the AVGN 8-bit Release Date Announcement Trailer here![previewyoutube="I0uO3xPU6II;full"][/previewyoutube]Experience the ULTIMATE NERD RAGE in Angry Video Game Nerd 8-bit!

The modern version from Programancer, features an 8-bit style with live-action cutscenes, making it feel like you’re playing an AVGN episode. Our friends at Mega Cat Studios will also be producing an NES cartridge version. Both the modern release and the NES carts will be available for physical pre-order soon through Limited Run Games.

As The Nerd, blast your way through pixel-art-packed levels with zombies, mechanical skeletons, ghoulish reapers, and more. Grab upgrades, slide through obstacles, and take down bosses plaguing every level!

[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/94851127ca67b81f1754719fce2e23e5d112f56b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/52bac2ea34adaa78aa612c7083f7b37d14738700.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/7be486e191e35ea79f7812150a91c85a3a731899.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/3bb7884ae1084b9aa5a1759b0d3c46688f8aa2c3.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/7777610554844d099038a3c766fef3814cfff1de.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/0772f33fafd0d5c8756eb899b34fb185224d58d0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/8477903ab477fc1970a3cea18da2fe3e9bf196a0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/5d9c21dfb57add03d61e385b6e9128030050508f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/09242f3daf472471551dac4cf459a10bcc4d3f01.png"][/carousel]We're excited to be releasing AVGN 8-bit on October 23, 2025!

notes.title: The Nerd Room at MAGFest!
notes.content:
Our team had loads of fun at MAGFest this year showing off AVGN 8-bit! And looking back on the event, we wanted to share how we created the Angry Video Game Nerd set for our booth set!

First, we got measurements from the actual set! Then, we got to work gathering the materials we needed, followed by the painting, drilling, and all that stuff! We also had to go into Photoshop to digitally recreate every shelf of "games" on the booth design, supporting the printed games with floral cubes!

After testing the entire build at our warehouse, we were set for MAGFest! We unloaded everything, put the booth together, set up an NES in a cabinet underneath a CRT TV, and away we went!

Take an in-depth look into our process with this video--narrated by THE NERD himself!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fSt39ZymjNU

...and some screenshots!
